messages:
sara: quick sync — i sketched a follow-up for the metering pipeline: shard key, minimal sync event for quota + async enriched event for billing/audit. https://go/repo/infra/metering-proposal :eyes:

priyanka: can you paste the shard-key idea? worried about hot customers and cross-region ordering.

sara: idea: shard_key = sha256(customer_id | day) so all a customer's events for a day go to same shard. keeps per-customer ordering and makes audits deterministic.

elliot: sha256(day) helps but hot tenants still hot. we should support adaptive hot-shard splitting (customer_id|hour or add replica suffix) and emit a stable seq number for audit. seq is per-customer per-day so ordering in storage -> deterministic audit.

tom: streaming + partial tokens complicate this. we currently emit token counts only at request end. streaming SDKs might want immediate quota checks. propose: emit a "prelim_event" on start with request_id + estimated_tokens, then "final_event" with definitive counts. reconciliation job dedups and adjusts billing.

bob_finance: +1 on deterministic seq. for invoicing we need stable attribution to product/route. how do we attach product_line? route mapping can change over time. audits need the mapping at request time.

priyanka: store route_tags on the enriched event and snapshot the mapping id (route_mapping_v) so audits reconstruct historical attribution. do not rely on live config.

ops-bot: pipeline-alert: metering-ingest lag > 90s for shard-17 at 1767890150 — investigation assigned to @elliot

elliot: saw the alert. replica lag due to a retry storm for a single hot cust. i'm adding backpressure and temporary spill-to-s3 for that shard.

sara: regarding event shape, proposed minimal sync event (for quota/limits) must be tiny and synchronous, e.g. 3 fields: request_id, cust_id, tokens_est. enriched async event has full metadata for billing and audits.

sara: example enriched event (draft):
```json
{
  "event_id": "uuidv4",
  "request_id": "r_ABC123",
  "customer_id": "cust_678",
  "model": "redwood/gpt-4o",
  "tokens_total": "143",
  "tokens_user": "120",
  "tokens_system": "23",
  "timestamp": "1767890123",
  "seq": "42",
  "shard_key": "sha256(cust_678|2026-03-07)",
  "route_tags": ["api.chat.create", "product:editor"],
  "route_mapping_v": "v23"
}
```

priyanka: minor nit: tokens should be ints not strings in storage, but ok for sketch. also we need schema versioning (evt_v) to evolve without breaking consumers.

tom: dedupe strategy: use (customer_id, seq, event_id) uniqueness. reconciliation job will emit corrections to billing if prelim estimate differs from final. record corrections in audit log (correction_event) to preserve history.

bob_finance: how will rounding/partial-token attribution work for multi-route requests? (e.g., one request used two sub-routes). we need per-subroute token breakout to map to billing buckets.

sara: agreed. enriched event should include breakdown: [{subroute, tokens}]. if small requests that adds overhead; we'll make this optional and only present when route split occurs (sdk/server side can request subroute detail).

elliot: ops considerations: retention policy for raw enriched events vs aggregated billing records. raw events must be retained for audits (compliance) 7 years? finance says 3 yrs for most customers but gov/reg accounts need longer. we should support configurable retention per-customer tier.

bob_finance: yes — tiered retention. and we need an immutable audit trail: once an enriched event is written, it can be corrected but we should append correction events rather than mutate. auditors rely on append-only history.

priyanka: implementation plan proposal:
- write minimal sync event through low-latency path to quota service (<=50ms)
- emit enriched event to kafka topic keyed by shard_key (sha256(cust|day))
- consumer writes to append-only store (parquet on s3 with manifest) and also to OLAP for analytics
- reconciliation job consumes prelim/final pairs and emits correction_events when needed
- maintain route_mapping snapshots in configstore with version ids
- schema version (evt_v) included in every event

tom: i like. a few tradeoffs: keyed kafka helps ordering but creates hot partitions; need autosplit+spill. also choosing day vs hour affects reconciliation window and manifest size.

sara: action items:
- @elliot prototype hot-shard spill + backpressure by EOD Wed
- @priyanka add evt_v and route_mapping_v to the spec doc and add examples by Thu
- @tom draft reconciliation correction_event spec and sample queries by Fri
- @bob_finance confirm retention requirements per-customer tier and share with compliance next Tue

priyanka: i'll also add a short section on privacy/PII redaction for enriched events (mask prompt text by default, store prompt_hash).

sara: thanks all — i'll sync this into the RFC thread and schedule a 30m follow-up next week to lock down defaults. :thumbsup:
